title: A Log That Tells You What Went Wrong: Reading a Field Run for Stuck, Slipping, Off the Path, Draining and Missing Time

artifact.note: reading a field log: rows of time, position, commanded and wheel speed, charge and cross-track error are scanned for the faults a ground vehicle has (stuck, wheels turning and the ground not moving, off the path, the charge draining faster than usual, and time missing from the log), each as a span with a size, with the rows of a flagged window marked so a span starts when the fault did, and spans too short to matter dropped
